en: Meet Scriber. Keep what matters from meetings, calls, and videos.
zh: 认识 Scriber。留下会议、通话和视频中的重要内容。
spoken: Meet Scriber. Keep what matters from meetings, calls, and videos.

en: Click the menu bar icon, or press Option R, to open the panel.
zh: 点击菜单栏图标，或按 Option R 呼出面板。
spoken: Click the menu bar icon, or press Option R, to open the panel.

en: Record system audio and your microphone, with separate controls.
zh: 电脑声音和麦克风，分别控制、按需录制。
spoken: Record system audio and your microphone, with separate controls.

en: Start recording, then get back to what you are doing.
zh: 开始录制，然后继续手头的事。
spoken: Start recording, then get back to what you are doing.

en: See the timer and audio levels. Rename your file as you record.
zh: 查看时长和声音电平，录制中也能直接修改文件名。
spoken: See the timer and audio levels. Rename your file as you record.

en: Need the picture too? Choose screen recording.
zh: 画面也想留下？选择录屏。
spoken: Need the picture too? Choose screen recording.

en: Select a region, a window, or your whole screen.
zh: 选择一块区域、一个窗口，或整块屏幕。
spoken: Select a region, a window, or your whole screen.

en: Get a video with sound, plus a separate audio file.
zh: 得到带声音的视频，以及一份独立音频。
spoken: Get a video with sound, plus a separate audio file.

zh: 只录音？保存一个 M4A 文件。
spoken: Audio only? One M four A file.

zh: 文件存在哪里，由你决定。

en: Play, rename, or find recordings in your history.
zh: 在历史中播放、改名，或定位录制文件。
spoken: Play, rename, or find recordings in your history.

en: Scriber. Record it. Put it to work.
spoken: Scriber. Record it. Put it to work.
